# Draft:Firey (Battle for Dream Island)

Firey is one of the main protagonists of the American animated web series Battle for Dream Island. He is an anthropomorphic fire that battled alongside 19 contestants for Dream Island in the first season, returning in the second and fourth season to compete again. He stayed with Four during the Battle for B.F.D.I split and starred as the titular character in a comic book created by Cary and Michael Huang before BFDI titled “Total Firey Island”.
